frequency_question: What proportion of strike threats by apex labor coalitions resulting from formal deadlock over wages/service conditions actually culminate in the initiation of an indefinite strike within the target 35-day window?
membership_rule: Includes: officially registered national union confederations or joint forums representing majority workforces in vital sectors (e.g., banking, transport, public utilities) that formally issue strike notices. Excludes: flash strikes by unorganized labor, wildcat strikes without central union authorization, or localized disputes affecting single institutions.
